title: Revise engineering entity while preserving identity
description: Apply a supported rename, move, or definition edit to the same existing entity while preserving its identity and identity-based designation. This behavior determines and applies the changed definition; retaining the resulting content uses the definition-retention behavior.
inputs: The existing entity identity and selected model state.
The proposed name, location, or definition changes for that entity.
preconditions: The selected state unambiguously identifies the existing entity.
The proposal is a supported evolution of that same entity within the same governed model.
A location change preserves semantic containment parentage when physical placement represents that relationship.
outputs: The revised definition and resulting state with the entity identity preserved.
An explicit revision outcome or explanation of why the proposal could not be applied as a supported same-entity change.
behavior: Apply the supported presentation, location, or definition change without generating a replacement identity.
Keep existing identity-based references designating the revised entity.
Distinguish the preserved entity identity from its changed content or model state.
Do not infer renewed approval or continued applicability of earlier evidence from identity preservation.

failure_behavior.condition: The proposed resulting state would make the identity ambiguous or replace it with another identity.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the conflict rather than reporting a successful identity-preserving revision.

failure_behavior.condition: The operation requires a split, merge, replacement, retirement reuse, or unsupported move.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the operation as outside this Function's supported same-entity evolution.

failure_behavior.condition: A proposed location change moves an SR to a different IR or an AR to a different SR.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the semantic parentage change and its need for reconsidered derivation and applicable authority; do not silently perform it as a presentation change.

failure_behavior.condition: The revision cannot be completed or its outcome cannot be confirmed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the known result and affected scope without claiming that the complete proposed revision succeeded.

unallocated_reason: Architectural allocation is deliberately deferred until Module responsibilities are designed; this draft claims no Module ownership or implementation.

sources.basis: SR-003 requires the same entity to retain its identity through supported name, location, and definition changes while preserving revision and evidence distinctions.
Apply the user-selected clarity and naming rule to this existing asset; refine its name and explanation without changing its identity, capability scope, or typed relationships.
